general_information.Description: This course is a model-based introduction to RE, providing the conceptual backgroud and terminology on RE, addressing a variety of techniques for - Analysis and Requirements Elicitation; - Requirements Evaluation; - Requirements Specification and Documentation; - Requirements Quality Assurance and demonstrating the Goal-Orientated Aproach in Requirements Engineering through - Modeling System Objectives with Goal Diagrams - Modeling Conceptual objects with Class diagrams - Moddeling System Agents and Responsibilities - Moddeling System Operations. During the course students are required to practice the RE techniques in class exercises and Assignments
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
general_information.Tools: Technical facility: - Visual Studio Express Edition (http://www.microsoft.com/express/download/) - Microsoft office for documents and presentation. - BOUML (http://bouml.free.fr/) : UML Drawing software
